title: HSBC UK enhances its £125 current account switch offer with a tasty addition - About HSBC | HSBC UK
description: HSBC UK enhances current account switch offer.

headings.text: HSBC UK enhances its £125 current account switch offer with a tasty addition

This enhanced time-limted offer is due to run for three weeks, expiring on Sunday 9 May 2021.
The Uber Eats voucher offers a £20 discount on items including delivery charge, can be used by both new and existing Uber Eats customers and in conjunction with other Uber Eats promotions.

In addition to the enhanced switching offer, customers can make significant savings on shopping through HSBC UK’s ‘Home And Away’ Opens in new window offers site, with popular offers recently added including Costa Coffee, ASOS, and Not On The High Street.

Fiona Anderson, HSBC UK’s Head of Everyday Banking, said: “Thanks to the recent easing of the lockdown measures, we have more options to safely meet with friends and family in our garden, so whether you decide to invest the £125 cash in your own barbecue and do it yourself, or use the £20 Uber Eats voucher for a timely food delivery, this could be a great way to help celebrate with your nearest and dearest.”
Steve Gracey, HSBC UK Media Relations – steve.gracey@hsbc.com / 020 7991 4118

Those switching to HSBC UK’s Advance or Premier Current Accounts will receive £125 when they switch using the Current Account Switch Service within 20 days of account opening and move at least two standing orders or Direct Debits. Customers will receive information on how to redeem their £20 Uber eats voucher within 20 days of the switch completion. The reward must be claimed within 30 days of that email.

This offer isn’t available to customers who hold an HSBC current account at the time of application or who’ve held one at any time since 1 January 2018, nor those who’ve opened a first direct account since 1 January 2018. If you opened your first account before 1 January 2018, you can still take advantage of the offer.

Conditions for an HSBC UK Advance Account include qualifying for a minimum £1,000 arranged overdraft, paying at least £1,750 a month into the account each month, or a minimum of £10,500 every 6 months. This does not include money transferred from any other sole or joint personal accounts held with HSBC UK Bank.

Conditions for an HSBC UK Premier Account include having an individual annual income of at least £75,000 and one of the following with HSBC UK: a mortgage, an investment, life insurance or a protection product; or within 6 months, having savings and/or investments of at least £50,000 with HSBC UK.
Uber Eats deliveries are not available in all geographic locations. Further offer and account T&Cs apply. For persons in the UK.

HSBC UK serves around 14.5 million customers across the UK, supported by 32,000 colleagues. HSBC UK offers a complete range of retail banking and wealth management to personal and private banking customers, as well as commercial banking for small to medium businesses and large corporates.

HSBC Holdings plc, the parent company of HSBC, is headquartered in London. HSBC serves customers worldwide from offices in 64 countries and territories in its geographical regions: Europe, Asia, North America, Latin America, and Middle East and North Africa. With assets of US$2,984bn at 31 December 2020, HSBC is one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations.
